analysis: Compare each scan-label candidate with its retained raw control; report closed topology counts and every unresolved label. Scan-label meshes are method units, not independent participants.

control.method: Previously retained raw voxel-boundary surfaces from the same source archive, scan, label set, and affine.

method: CPU-only exact occupied-voxel-union triangles. Pair ordinary two-face edges by incidence and four-face contacts by source voxel owner; split triangle-corner fans by vertex index. Keep unresolved edge/vertex defects visible in the receipt and serialized candidate.

predictions_before_source_run.geometry: For every surface, triangle coordinates in face order, triangle count, winding, surface area, and reported signed volume remain exactly equal to the raw candidate; independent signed occupancy-volume error stays at most 1e-9.
predictions_before_source_run.independent_integrity: Independent PLY serialization, coordinates, indices, topology, bounds, and source occupancy checks pass for all emitted candidates.
predictions_before_source_run.qualification_boundary: External automatic-segmentation geometry only; no expert accuracy, cross-scan registration, Numi subject binding, physical ownership, mechanics, physiology, or clinical anatomy.
predictions_before_source_run.source_identity: All 12 labels reproduce the pinned archive, NIfTI hash, affine, voxel counts, and occupancy volumes.
predictions_before_source_run.topology: No raw closed surface becomes nonmanifold. At least 10 of 12 raw nonmanifold surfaces become closed two-manifolds; any residual contact remains explicitly counted and named.

purpose: Exploratory follow-up after v1 failed closed-topology admission; preserves and audits any residual source contacts instead of dropping the run.
stopping_and_exclusion_rules: One compile attempt per scan; no retries under this plan.
Any identity, label-count, triangle-coordinate, face-count, area, volume, envelope, PLY, or independent-audit failure refutes the corresponding prediction and remains recorded.

Do not omit unresolved meshes or interpret vertex duplication as physical clearance. Do not smooth, interpolate, decimate, modify the voxel labels, or promote the outputs to clinical anatomy or mechanics.
